tasks.short: Develop and apply physical theories and laws.

steps.what: Examine actual observations and experiments, checking measurement uncertainty and assumptions relevant to the physical problem
Develop theories and laws from observations and experiments, choosing physical assumptions and deriving implications
Apply the formulation to a nuclear, optical or aerospace problem through explicit symbolic or numerical calculations in scientific analysis software {OTHER}
Write and check the theoretical result against observations, units, limiting cases and validity boundaries
Save the checked theory and application record in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Use native symbolic or numerical setup in scientific analysis software {OTHER} for repeated explicit calculations. The physicist develops the theory, chooses assumptions and checks physical validity; neither solver execution nor generated conjectures count as scientific understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applying a formulation can repeat mechanical calculations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameterized calculations can reuse explicit equations.
tasks.still_hard: Formulating a theory that explains observations and survives attempts to refute it.
tasks.human_edge: Physical insight and critical treatment of assumptions.

ambition.what: No new discovery or faster theoretical breakthrough is promised.

tasks.altitude: Less calculation setup, unchanged scientific authority.

evidence.claim: Native symbolic and numerical tools can repeat explicit calculations, while theoretical formulation and physical validation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes theory development and its application record, not new experimental data collection or deploying a safety-critical system. Existing measurements are inputs, not free new capture.

Experiment records supply observation ID, value, unit, method, calibration and uncertainty; the physicist checks them in s1 and supplies equations and parameters in s2-s3. Missing values require manual source verification within retained work.

Native tools first. Only repeated calculation setup changes; theory choice, derivation meaning and final physical checking remain full. Solver runtime is excluded. Normal author check in s4 binds the exact saved record. Shares are provisional estimates.
unknowns: How much calculation setup is genuinely repeated rather than novel reasoning.
research_questions: Can reusable calculations preserve assumptions and pass independent limiting-case checks?

already_counted.description: Observation assessment, theory development and final physical checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain reusable calculation setup and unit checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact theoretical record checked in s4; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 25% less calculation setup on 25 share saves 6.25 points less 1 upkeep. Low is a novel formulation without reusable calculation; no theoretical reasoning saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual scientific paper, methods, figures and supporting material under the review conditions
Perform peer reviews by judging physical arguments, methods, evidence, novelty and unsupported conclusions
Write and check the actual peer-review comments, recommendation and appropriate editor or author visibility in the journal review portal {OTHER}
Save the checked review in the journal portal {OTHER}
Submit the checked review to the journal editor through {OTHER}

tasks.design: Keep paper reading, scientific judgement and actual review writing with the physicist. The existing journal portal {OTHER} already provides the review form; a generated summary does not remove the need to assess the paper or write defensible comments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Review quality depends on understanding the actual argument and evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional capability establishes a reduction in substantive peer review.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting subtle physical or methodological weaknesses.
tasks.human_edge: Independent scientific criticism and fair feedback.

ambition.what: No additional review volume is assumed.

reach.task: Explain the importance of a technical flaw
reach.learn: Separate evidence problems from editorial preference.

evidence.claim: Scientific peer review requires actual manuscript reading and judgement; a native form alone does not automate that work.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual reading, review writing, save and external submission, explicitly split before zero. No correspondence or report writing is hidden in the reading step.

The journal supplies actual manuscript version, supporting files and review conditions. The physicist produces assessment and comments in s2-s3. Missing evidence is flagged or checked manually; no generated reference or unprovided experiment is accepted.

Native review form is already the baseline. Substantive comment writing is not treated as repeated formatting. No model service or system change is introduced, so upkeep is zero. Normal final checking in s3 binds exact content, editor destination and visibility; any edit voids both gates.
unknowns: Actual journal review conditions and supporting-material completeness.
research_questions: Is any real repeated administrative entry present beyond the native review form?

already_counted.description: Reading, scientific judgement and actual review writing remain counted.

incremental.description: No system change or model service.

approvals.approved_version: Exact review content checked in s3; edits require recheck.
Exact review, editor destination and visibility checked in s3; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Full manuscript reading, scientific assessment, actual comment writing and ordinary save/submission remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define application requirements and evaluation criteria for actual electro-optical devices
Design the evaluation setup, measurement conditions and controls
Conduct application evaluations on the actual electro-optical device and capture calibrated measurements and deviations
Calculate explicit response, noise, spectral or efficiency comparisons in scientific analysis software {OTHER}
Analyze results to determine suitable uses and write and check actual application findings and limitations
Save the checked evaluation record in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure reusable explicit measurement comparisons in scientific analysis software {OTHER}. The physicist designs and conducts the evaluation and determines suitable uses; only repeated calculation assembly changes, with actual device measurements retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated response calculations can interrupt application evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analysis tools can reuse declared calculations and units.
tasks.still_hard: Translating test performance into a defensible use under actual conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Physical measurement judgement and application context.

ambition.what: No clinical, military or other deployment authority is added.

tasks.altitude: Less calculation assembly, unchanged suitability judgement.

evidence.claim: Explicit electro-optical measurement calculations can use native analysis tools, while experiments and application suitability remain human work.

assumptions: Boundary includes application evaluation and its actual record, not qualifying a product for deployment or replacing a required external authorization.

The physicist produces device ID, condition, actual measured response, unit, calibration and deviation in s3, whose full capture effort remains. Missing digital readings are manually entered and checked within retained s4 work; no new free instrument feed is assumed.

Native analysis first. Only repeated computation changes, not measurement design, physical operation or interpretation. The normal final check in s5 binds the saved record. Scientific instrument software is the named category for {OTHER}; no live control is automated.
unknowns: Current calculation reuse and measurement export quality.
research_questions: Can reusable calculations preserve calibration and condition metadata?

already_counted.description: Criteria, evaluation design and actual device testing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain measurement calculations and unit mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact evaluation findings checked in s5; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 30% less calculation assembly on 20 share saves 6 points less 1 upkeep. Low is existing analysis templates or incompatible measurements; no device-testing saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop fabrication processes for optical devices.

steps.what: Define device physics, tolerances and process requirements for lasers, masers, infrared or other light-emitting or light-sensitive devices
Choose compatible manufacturing, assembly and fabrication methods, materials and process windows
Develop the explicit process layouts, tolerance calculations and assembly sequence in engineering design software {OTHER}
Evaluate actual fabrication trials or prototypes and revise the process based on observed defects and physical limits
Write and check the completed fabrication process specification and limits against actual trial evidence
Save the checked fabrication process specification in the controlled draft repository {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure reusable geometry and tolerance calculations in engineering design software {OTHER}. The physicist selects fabrication methods, evaluates actual trials and writes the process specification; the saved draft does not release equipment instructions or change a production machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated layout and tolerance setup can distract from process physics.
tasks.enabler_now: Native design tools can reuse explicit geometry and calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Material compatibility, manufacturability and physical trial failures.
tasks.human_edge: Process insight and recognizing why a prototype fails.

ambition.what: No extra production throughput or automatic process release is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less repetitive design assembly, unchanged fabrication judgement.

evidence.claim: Native engineering tools can reuse geometry and tolerance calculations, while fabrication choices and trial interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is developing and saving a process draft, not operating a manufacturing line or authorizing production release. Other staff's fabrication and trial runtime are not counted as focal savings; the physicist's actual trial evaluation remains in s4.

Design records supply device ID, geometry, material and tolerance; trial staff or the physicist supply actual trial ID, measured defect and test conditions. Missing trial data is manually verified within s4-s5, not inferred from a planned process.

Native design features first. Only repeated geometry and calculation setup changes, not process choice or physical testing. Normal completed-specification check in s5 binds the saved draft. Any later release retains its own existing authority and receives no saving here.
unknowns: Existing design reuse and the actual share of novel process development.
research_questions: Can reusable layout calculations remain valid when materials or process windows change?

already_counted.description: Requirements, process selection, actual trial evaluation and specification checking remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final process draft checked in s5; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 25% less repetitive design assembly on 30 share saves 7.5 points less 1 upkeep. Low is a novel process or native reuse already present; no physical trial saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native calculation and design tools while retaining scientific formulation, measurement judgement and peer review.
reach: Explain physical validity and measurement limits to device and manufacturing engineers.
role.ambitious_version: A physicist whose reusable tools make assumptions visible without replacing scientific scrutiny.
